media.altText: Black-and-white portrait photograph of the lyricist Marc-Cab.
media.publicCaption: Marc-Cab — Marcel Cabridens, born in Nice in 1901 and died at Bandol in 1978 — who wrote the French lyrics of Vivons l’amour! Vivons la vie, C’est chez nous and Un baiser de femme sous un ciel de feu in 1934 and of Celui que j’aime in 1939. The photograph is undated.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unnamed; captioned "Marc Cab — Photo coll. ANAO" in the Encyclopédie multimédia de la comédie musicale théâtrale en France.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The photograph carries no photographer and no date; the Encyclopédie captions it as coming from the ANAO collection and states that its illustrations remain the copyright of their respective publishers and rightsholders, granting no licence of its own. Without a photographer or a date of publication no term can be computed, and a French photograph of this period would in any case have had its United States copyright restored by the URAA if it was still protected in France in 1996. A reduced-resolution reproduction (320 × 399 px, from 401 × 500 px) is used here for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator.
